Srimanikandan Ramamoorthy

Senior Director - Finance

With 17+ years of experience serving clients across multiple industry verticals in the USA, we deliver high-quality outcomes on time, maintain very low attrition and resource turnover across projects, and bring focused teams with wide-ranging expertise.
